script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Moses being Israel's leader before Joshua is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Moses being Israel's leader before Joshua is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The text specifies uncut stones with no iron tool used on them. It does not say Joshua took them exactly as they were, with no touching up.
The text does not say nobody polished the stones. Uncut stones with no iron tool used on them are not necessarily unpolished.
The text does not say the stones stayed exactly as they came or that Joshua was not tempted to add a swirl. It also does not say carving would have required an iron chisel.
The passage says the altar was built according to the Book and that offerings were made on it. It does not say the Book prescribed those offerings.
The passage includes foreigners and citizens on both sides of the ark, but it does not say they stood next to one another.
The people stood in front of the mountains, not on them.
The passage places the people in front of the mountains, not on the mountainsides. It also does not say nobody was taking attendance.
The passage does not say nobody was sent to wait outside.
The passage does not mention nearby kings at the reading, but it does not say they were excluded from a guest list.
